sentence: Please remember to give the project to the teacher before Friday.
synonym: hand in the project to the teacher
synonymNote: hand in表示上交作业，与give the project to the teacher意思相同

distractors.word: show the project to the teacher
distractors.note: show是展示给老师看，不是上交给老师

distractors.word: send the project to the teacher
distractors.note: send通常指邮寄或发送，不是直接递交

distractors.word: explain the project to the teacher
distractors.note: explain是向老师解释项目，不是交给老师
